external.description: Strudel is a music live coding environment for the browser, porting the TidalCycles pattern language to JavaScript.
external.title: Strudel REPL

record.text:
I want to put more time into creative hobbies, too many hobbies I have are just about socializing or consuming, and I've been feeling that itch to create for quite a while now.

Writing and making music are the things I currently want to do the most, Strudel.cc and learning to play the Ocarina...
